title: What Motivates Us Really?
coreMove: Trace the impulse to the uncomfortable feeling it is trying to quiet before blaming the nearest device.
sourcePressure: The opening move says distraction usually starts with internal discomfort, while devices and apps are downstream channels for relief.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would make the phone the villain and skip the boredom, anxiety, or uncertainty that made the phone attractive.

hook: What Motivates Us Really? as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: night-shift emergency dispatch after a long quiet stretch
exampleSpecs.audience: dispatcher who mistakes unease for a need to refresh news
exampleSpecs.stakes: a missed rest window becomes another brittle hour on console
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes 'restless silence' on the incident pad before touching the news tab
exampleSpecs.firstImage: An amber call light glows beside an untouched incident pad.

exampleSpecs.domain: pastry kitchen during a slow dough proof
exampleSpecs.audience: baker tempted to scroll while waiting for dough to rise
exampleSpecs.stakes: the batch timer loses authority when boredom is unnamed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he circles 'waiting itch' in the proofing log and leaves the tablet face down
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A proofing log lies beside a tray of pale croissants.

exampleSpecs.domain: probate paralegal opening a difficult estate file
exampleSpecs.audience: paralegal who calls legal research productive while avoiding grief-heavy paperwork
exampleSpecs.stakes: a family deadline slips because the hard emotion hides inside a respectable task
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she touches the sealed estate envelope, says 'sadness first,' and opens the inventory instead of a case-law search
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A sealed estate envelope rests under a brass letter opener.

exampleSpecs.domain: amateur cellist starting a metronome session
exampleSpecs.audience: adult learner who checks messages whenever practice sounds rough
exampleSpecs.stakes: the practice hour turns into proof that talent is fixed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he names embarrassment when the bow squeaks, then restarts the metronome without checking messages
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A rosin cloth is folded beside a ticking metronome.

exampleSpecs.domain: farmers market stall after a slow first hour
exampleSpecs.audience: vendor reaching for social media to escape the sting of no buyers
exampleSpecs.stakes: fresh inventory wilts while attention leaks into comparison
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, she refreshes another vendor's photos; after, she labels the sting as comparison and rearranges the plum baskets
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Purple plums sit in shallow wooden baskets under a price slate.

exampleSpecs.domain: medical lab bench waiting on a centrifuge cycle
exampleSpecs.audience: technician who opens a gossip thread whenever the machine hums
exampleSpecs.stakes: chain-of-custody focus weakens during dead minutes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he identifies the trigger as empty waiting time and writes the next sample label before the rotor stops
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A centrifuge rotor hums beneath a row of blank sample labels.
